data.name: Jet Ski Rentals
data.headline: $72.08 – $242.74 • 1 or 2 Hour Rentals
data.description:
## Attention
• Credit card used for payment must be presented at check-in and must match name on reservation

• Arrive 30 minutes prior to reservation start time for safety and orientation briefing

• 18+ to drive (w/valid driver's license) 

• All riders must be at least 4' tall (no minimum age for passengers)

• Maximum allowed weight on jet ski is 450 lbs total

• Max of two people per ski for duration of reservation (no switching of passengers allowed)

• Neoprene shorts included for free upon request for protection of cavities
data.what_is_included: 30 Minutes to 2 Hour Jet Ski Rentals. Includes rental of ski, fuel, life jacket.
data.cancellation_notes:
Your credit card will be charged for the full cost of your rental upon reservation. To make changes or cancellations, you MUST notify us 24 hours in advance of jet ski reservation and 72 hours in advance for boat reservation, otherwise we will not be able to alter your reservation in any way. You will receive a full refund for cancellation due to weather (at discretion of company management).

If booking is made on the same day of reservation, there will be no refund for cancellation.

Rebookings are allowed 24 hours in advance of reservation, however, no refunds will be provided for reservations that have been rebooked.
